title: The Take-Up Share Assumed where a Micro Market Kiosk has Traded Heavily
content:
A year of heavy drawing at the kiosk of an Unattended Micro Market Program market moves the take-up share the next funding lot is sized on, and whether the market has been closed off over that year settles which way it moves.

## Conditions and shares

**The heavy take-up of 35 per cent** applies where at or above 3000 USD has been drawn at the kiosk over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out, and no suspension request stands approved on the agreement over those twelve months.

**The light take-up of 18 per cent** applies where at or above 3000 USD has been drawn at the kiosk over those twelve months, and a suspension request stands approved on the agreement over them.

**Where less than 3000 USD has been drawn at the kiosk over those twelve months**, no such change to the take-up share is made.

## The boundary

The active-kiosk year amount is 3000 USD drawn at the kiosk over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out: exactly 3000.00 USD is at or above it, and 2999.99 USD is below it. The second limb turns on a single approved suspension request standing over those same twelve months.

*Hypothetical.* A site reporting a badged headcount of 520, on an agreement where 5200.00 USD was drawn at the kiosk over the trailing year with no approved suspension request, is sized on a take-up share of 35 per cent, giving an expected need for one month of 3640.00 USD. With an approved suspension request standing over that year, the take-up share would be 18 per cent and the monthly figure 1872.00 USD.
